Name: BFAV Phoenixes
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
BFAV version of the Firebirds mod.  Thanks to SpringsSong for converting the mod and making it drop phoenix specific items.

If you have Artisan Valley, you can get phoenix mayos.  However Artisan Valley isn't required for this mod to work.
[b]
[code][/code]Install Instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV) (must be [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-14#post-3353517]version 3.0.6[/url]﻿-unofficial or newer)
[*]Install Json Assets.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it's contents.
[*]Copy the [BFAV] AND [JA] into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
